name: How long does water heater installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does water heater installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard water heater installations can be completed within 2 to 4 hours. However, this timeframe can vary if significant modifications are needed, such as converting from a tank to a tankless unit, or changing from electric to gas. Our technicians work efficiently to minimize disruption, and we always provide an estimated completion time before beginning the work. We prioritize a safe and thorough installation over rushing the job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard water heater installations typically take 2-4 hours. Complex jobs, like type conversions, may require more time.
